items.title: Lightswind UI：命令行装进项目、源码归你的 React 动画组件库（带 MCP）
items.titleEn: Lightswind UI: a CLI-first React animated component library whose source you own (with MCP)
items.hook: 一条命令把动画组件源码拷进项目，也能让助手经 MCP 挑选安装。
items.hookEn: One command copies animated component source into your repo, or let an agent pick via MCP.
items.summary: Lightswind UI 是 MIT 开源的 React + Tailwind 动画组件库，走 shadcn 那条「源码进你项目」的路：`npx lightswind@latest init` 识别 Next.js / Vite / CRA 并装好公共工具，再用 `npx lightswind add 组件名` 把单个组件拷到 components/lightswind/ 下，之后随便改。另一个卖点是自带 MCP：`npx lightswind mcp init` 可给 Cursor / Claude Desktop 配好，让编程助手自己浏览、取用、安装组件；README 也写了 GitHub Copilot。组件以动效为主（3D 轮播、滚动触发、着色器背景、Hero 等），README 写 160+ 个，官网各处自称数量不一，这里不替它定数。官网同时卖 Pro 授权（额外的付费组件、页面模板和需登录的 CLI 下发），首页还挂着促销横幅；本条只讲免费、MIT 的那部分，不用 Pro 也能用。适合想给落地页、作品集快速加动效，又不想引入运行时依赖的人。
items.summaryEn: Lightswind UI is an MIT React + Tailwind animated component library that follows the shadcn idea of putting source in your project: `npx lightswind@latest init` detects Next.js / Vite / CRA and installs shared utilities, then `npx lightswind add <name>` copies one component into components/lightswind/ for you to edit. Its other selling point is a built-in MCP: `npx lightswind mcp init` configures Cursor / Claude Desktop so a coding agent can browse, fetch, and install components itself; the README also mentions GitHub Copilot. The components lean on motion (3D carousels, scroll triggers, shader backgrounds, heroes); the README says 160+, while the site quotes different counts in different places, so no exact number is given here. The site also sells a Pro license (extra paid components, page templates, and authenticated CLI delivery) and runs a promo banner; this entry covers only the free MIT part, which works without Pro. Good for adding motion to landing pages or portfolios without a runtime dependency.
items.promptHint: 在 React + Tailwind 项目根目录跑 `npx lightswind@latest init`，再 `npx lightswind add 组件名` 装一个免费组件，从 components/lightswind/ 引入后按自己的品牌改颜色和动效时长。想让助手挑组件就跑 `npx lightswind mcp init`。别默认去装 Pro 组件，也别从 "lightswind" 包直接 import。
items.promptHintEn: In a React + Tailwind project root run `npx lightswind@latest init`, then `npx lightswind add <name>` for one free component; import it from components/lightswind/ and retune colors and motion timing for your brand. Run `npx lightswind mcp init` if you want an agent to pick components. Do not assume Pro components are free, and do not import from the "lightswind" package directly.
items.qualityNote: 收录理由：成熟度较高的 MIT 动画组件库，CLI 拷源码加 MCP 让助手安装，正好接上 AI 编程流程。边界：官网另售 Pro，本条只写免费 MIT 路径；组件数量 README 与官网说法不一，未逐个核对。本库没有跑 init，没有接 MCP，也没有购买或使用 Pro。
items.qualityNoteEn: Why: a fairly mature MIT animated component library where the CLI copies source and an MCP lets agents install it, which fits AI coding workflows. Boundary: the site also sells Pro; this entry covers only the free MIT path. Component counts differ between the README and the site and were not audited one by one. This library did not run init, did not wire the MCP, and did not buy or use Pro.

items.title: Intelli UI：MIT 开源的 Liquid Glass 风格 React 组件库（CLI、MCP、助手插件）
items.titleEn: Intelli UI: an MIT Liquid Glass React component library (CLI, MCP, agent plugin)
items.hook: 磨砂玻璃风的 React 组件，命令行拷进项目，也能让助手装。
items.hookEn: Frosted-glass React components you copy in with a CLI, or have an agent install.
items.summary: Intelli UI（IntelliHelper 出品）是一套 MIT 开源的 Liquid Glass（磨砂玻璃）风格组件库，面向 React / Next.js + Tailwind，交互底层用 Radix UI。用法和 shadcn 一样：`npx @intellihelper/cli@latest init`，再 `add button card dialog`，源码落进你自己的仓库。它把界面分成「安静的外壳层」和「饱和的内容层」两种玻璃，附 mono、aurora、sunset、frost、ocean 五套主题。给编程助手的入口有两个：MCP 服务 intellihelper-ui（README 列了 Cursor、Claude Code、VS Code、Codex 等），以及 agent-skills 插件（Claude / Grok 等可装）。组件数官网写 131+，README 写 80+，以官网组件页为准。项目很新、关注者很少，适合想试 Liquid Glass 视觉、愿意自己审代码的人，暂不建议直接上生产。
items.summaryEn: Intelli UI (by IntelliHelper) is an MIT Liquid Glass (frosted glass) component library for React / Next.js + Tailwind, with Radix UI underneath for interactive behavior. It works like shadcn: `npx @intellihelper/cli@latest init`, then `add button card dialog`, and the source lands in your repo. It splits UI into a quiet chrome layer and saturated content panels, and ships five themes: mono, aurora, sunset, frost, ocean. For coding agents there is an MCP server, intellihelper-ui (the README lists Cursor, Claude Code, VS Code, Codex and others), plus an agent-skills plugin for Claude, Grok, and more. The site says 131+ components while the README says 80+; trust the site's component pages. The project is very new with a small following—good for trying the Liquid Glass look if you will review the code yourself, not yet something to drop straight into production.
items.promptHint: 在 Next.js + Tailwind 项目里跑 `npx @intellihelper/cli@latest init`，再 `npx @intellihelper/cli@latest add button card dialog`，先挑一个主题（如 frost）做一张设置页，外壳用安静的玻璃层、主内容用饱和面板。装进来的源码要自己过一遍再用。
items.promptHintEn: In a Next.js + Tailwind project run `npx @intellihelper/cli@latest init`, then `npx @intellihelper/cli@latest add button card dialog`; pick one theme (e.g. frost) and build a settings page with quiet glass chrome and a saturated main panel. Review the copied source before shipping it.
items.qualityNote: 收录理由：Liquid Glass 是当下热门视觉方向，这套 MIT 组件库把它做成可拷贝源码，并给了 CLI、MCP 和助手插件。边界：项目很早期，GitHub 星标很少，维护前景未知；组件数官网与 README 不一致。本库没有安装 CLI、没有接 MCP 或插件，也没有做生产级审查。
items.qualityNoteEn: Why: Liquid Glass is a popular visual direction right now, and this MIT library turns it into copyable source with a CLI, MCP, and agent plugin. Boundary: the project is very early with very few GitHub stars, so its maintenance outlook is unknown; component counts differ between the site and the README. This library did not install the CLI, did not wire the MCP or plugin, and did not do a production-grade review.

items.hook: 半调、拼贴框、颗粒叠层这类视觉件，一条 shadcn 命令装进项目。
items.hookEn: Halftone, collage frames, grain overlays—install with one shadcn command.

items.title: Glaze：给 AI 产品用的黑白玻璃设计系统（shadcn 一条命令装）
items.titleEn: Glaze — a glassy black-and-white design system for AI products, installed with shadcn
items.hook: 提示框、推理、工具调用、自主权限都有现成组件，还带给助手读的规则。
items.hookEn: Prompt input, reasoning, tool calls and autonomy rules, plus a skill for the agent.
items.summary: Glaze 是 Arlan Marat 在 design.how 上放出的第三套设计系统，定位「给 AI 产品用」：整体黑白、紧凑，只有下一步要按的那个按钮用玻璃质感。它走 shadcn 注册表，`npx shadcn@latest add https://design.how/r/glaze/theme.json` 装主题，同时把 Glaze 的 SKILL.md 写进 .claude/skills 和 .agents/skills，让编程助手按它的规则改界面。注册表列出 87 项：常规输入、表格、弹层之外，AI 一栏有 Prompt input、Send button、Mention、Message、Conversation、Response、Reasoning、Tool call、Activity、Follow-ups、Action receipt、Autonomy rule；还有 11 个整屏区块（预订审批、引用回答、Agent 计划、模拟测试等）和一份 ESLint 规则包，用来挡掉不在 token 里的数值。代码和技能在 GitHub 仓库 arla6ka/design.how，MIT 许可。官网复制安装提示词前会弹邮箱框，可以点「Just copy the prompt」跳过。适合要做 Agent 产品、又不想每屏重新设计审批卡和工具调用卡的人。本库读了注册表和组件源码，没有在项目里实际装上跑。
items.summaryEn: Glaze is the third design system Arlan Marat has published on design.how, aimed at AI products: compact black and white, with glass only on the one button you press next. It ships as a shadcn registry: `npx shadcn@latest add https://design.how/r/glaze/theme.json` installs the theme and writes the Glaze SKILL.md into .claude/skills and .agents/skills so a coding agent follows its rules. The registry lists 87 items. Beyond inputs, tables and overlays, the AI group has Prompt input, Send button, Mention, Message, Conversation, Response, Reasoning, Tool call, Activity, Follow-ups, Action receipt and Autonomy rule; there are 11 full-screen blocks (booking approval, cited answer, agent plan, simulations and more) and an ESLint pack that flags values outside the tokens. Code and skills live in the GitHub repo arla6ka/design.how under MIT. The site shows an email box before copying the install prompt; “Just copy the prompt” skips it. Good if you are building an agent product and do not want to redesign approval and tool-call cards on every screen. This library read the registry and component source but did not install it into a project.
items.promptHint: 先 npx shadcn@latest add https://design.how/r/glaze/theme.json，在根布局引入样式并给 body 加 glaze 类；再按需 add prompt-input、tool-call、autonomy-rule。改界面前先读 .agents/skills/glaze/SKILL.md，改完跑 glaze.eslint.config.mjs。
items.promptHintEn: Run npx shadcn@latest add https://design.how/r/glaze/theme.json, import the stylesheet in the root layout and add the glaze class to body, then add prompt-input, tool-call and autonomy-rule as needed. Read .agents/skills/glaze/SKILL.md before UI changes and run glaze.eslint.config.mjs after.

items.title: Chai UI：生成式 AI 应用的提示栏与结果卡组件（React / Vue）
items.titleEn: Chai UI — prompt bar and result-card components for generative AI apps (React / Vue)
items.hook: 一条提示栏管模型选择、提示词优化和附件，结果卡自带重试与下载。
items.hookEn: One prompt bar for model picking, prompt rewriting and attachments; result cards retry.
items.summary: Chai UI 是 MIT 开源的「AI 交互设计系统」，把图像、视频类 AI 应用里反复出现的界面做成四个组件：Composer（提示栏：附件、用途、模型菜单、提示词优化、自动选模型、停止按钮，可选语音输入和世界模型的 Environment / Character 双提示）、MediaAnalyzer（丢进图片、视频或音频，反推一段可用的提示词）、ResultCard（一次生成的结果，带点赞、重试、下载、分享和翻面看参数）、EditCard（在图上框选区域、每块写一句修改指令，再按版本翻页）。React 与 Vue 各一套，组件和行为相同；设计 token 另有 CSS 变量、JS 和 Figma token 集。后端可接 Fal.ai、OpenRouter、Vercel AI Gateway 或你自己的引擎，密钥只放在你服务器上的一个路由里。不接后端时整套跑内置 mock，不发网络请求，适合先把界面搭起来。项目自述仍在积极开发，版本 0.10.x。本库用 React 装了 0.10.1，不接引擎跑通了提示栏到结果卡；没有接 Fal、OpenRouter，也没有试编辑卡和 Vue 版。
items.summaryEn: Chai UI is an MIT “design system for AI model interactions” that turns the parts every image and video AI app rebuilds into four components: Composer (prompt bar with attachments, use cases, a model menu, prompt optimization, auto model routing and stop; optional voice input and world-model Environment / Character prompts), MediaAnalyzer (drop in an image, video or audio clip and get a usable prompt back), ResultCard (one generation’s results with like, retry, download, share and a details flip) and EditCard (mark regions on an image, give each its own instruction, then page through versions). React and Vue packages have the same components and behaviour; design tokens also ship as CSS variables, JS and a Figma token set. Engines cover Fal.ai, OpenRouter, Vercel AI Gateway or your own, with keys kept in one route on your server. With no engine it runs on built-in mocks and makes no network calls, so you can lay out the UI first. The project says it is in active development at 0.10.x. This library installed 0.10.1 in React and ran the prompt bar through to a result card without an engine; it did not connect Fal or OpenRouter, or try EditCard or the Vue package.
items.promptHint: pnpm add @chai-ui/react @chai-ui/core @chai-ui/tokens，引入 @chai-ui/tokens/css 和 @chai-ui/react/style.css，先不传 engine 用 mock 搭好 Composer + ResultCard；要接真模型再加 createChaiHandler 服务端路由，把 FAL_KEY 或 OPENROUTER_API_KEY 放服务器环境变量。
items.promptHintEn: pnpm add @chai-ui/react @chai-ui/core @chai-ui/tokens, import @chai-ui/tokens/css and @chai-ui/react/style.css, and build Composer + ResultCard on mocks with no engine first; for real models add the createChaiHandler server route and keep FAL_KEY or OPENROUTER_API_KEY in server env.
items.qualityNote: MIT 开源。本库只在 React 里用内置 mock 跑过提示栏和结果卡；在那次试用里单按 Enter 没有提交，点发送按钮才出结果。没有接任何真实模型或服务端路由，没有试 EditCard、MediaAnalyzer 和 Vue 包，无障碍声明照 README。

items.summary: 一个免费开源的小工具，把 Claude Code 干活的过程画成一场视频会议：主 Agent 是组长，派活时子 Agent 一个个「入会」，各自是坐在桌前的小角色，轮到谁说话谁就进大画面，还有真人配音、口型同步和字幕。某个 Agent 跑命令或改文件时，它会「共享屏幕」，你能看到真实的终端输出、正在读的文件或改动的那几行；做完汇报后过一会儿离会。一眼就能看出谁在等谁、谁卡住了：命令跑超一分钟的小窗会闪黄、三分钟没动静显示睡着、失败的调用有红色计数，还有每个 Agent 用了多少 token、上下文快满的提醒、一棵「谁派活给谁」的树。它只读取 Claude Code 本来就写在本地的会话文件，不额外调用模型（除非你开法语翻译或玩笑台词），所以作者说「零 token 成本」。能当 VS Code / Cursor 扩展、终端命令或 macOS 小应用用，可回放过去的会话、导出带配音的 MP4。界面有简体中文。作者自己也说「主要是好玩」，但对同时开好几个 Agent 的人，确实是一种更直观的盯进度方式。
items.summaryEn: A free, open-source tool that draws Claude Code’s work as a video call: the main agent is the lead, sub-agents “join” as they get tasks, each a small character at a desk, and whoever speaks takes the big frame with real voices, lip-sync, and subtitles. When an agent runs a command or edits a file it “shares its screen,” showing real terminal output, the file it reads, or the exact lines it changes, and it leaves the call a while after reporting back. You can see at a glance who is waiting on whom and who is stuck: a tile pulses amber when a command runs over a minute, shows asleep after three quiet minutes, and counts failed calls in red, plus per-agent token use, a context-fullness warning, and a tree of who asked whom. It only reads the session files Claude Code already writes locally and calls no model (unless you turn on French translation or jokes), hence “zero token cost.” Use it as a VS Code / Cursor extension, a terminal command, or a small macOS app; replay past sessions and export voiced MP4s. The interface includes Simplified Chinese. The author says it is mostly for fun, but for anyone running several agents at once it is a more visual way to keep track.

Before exporting video, turn on the hide-code option in ⚙ → Tools, though what agents say aloud is not masked.

items.title: Open Intelligent UI：开源版「会自己出界面的聊天」，换上你的设计系统和组件
items.titleEn: Open Intelligent UI: an open-source chat that answers with interactive UI, built on your design system
items.summary: CopilotKit 开源的一套聊天界面模板，思路和 ChatGPT 10 月上线的 Intelligent UI 一样：你问一个问题，由 Agent 判断该回一段字、一个现成组件，还是当场生成一块能操作的小界面。官方演示里有四种：能拖滑块转的 3D 飞机（讲俯仰、横滚、偏航）、先出表格再一句话变成图表、能改总额/小费/人数的分账计算器、带编号图钉和地点照片的海岸行程地图。和直接用 ChatGPT 的区别是：代码 MIT 开源，你可以克隆下来，接自己的模型、自己的组件和设计规范（仓库里有单独的 design-system 包放主题、SVG 和表单样式），再改成自己产品里的回答方式；生成的 HTML/CSS/JS 放在隔离的 iframe 里跑。技术上前端是 Next.js + CopilotKit，后端是 Python Agent；默认用 OpenAI 的 chat-latest 写回答，用 TypeSafe 的 Jev 模型决定每轮该出哪种界面——简单表格走 A2UI，图表、示意图、计算器、地图走 Open Generative UI。另有一个可选的 MCP 服务，能把同样的出界面能力给别的 Agent 宿主用。适合做 AI 产品、想让回答不只是一段字的设计师和前端。
items.summaryEn: CopilotKit's open-source chat template built on the same idea as the Intelligent UI ChatGPT shipped in October: ask a question and the agent decides whether to answer with text, a native component, or a small interactive UI generated on the spot. The official demos show four: a 3D airplane you rotate with sliders (pitch, roll, yaw), a table that turns into a chart with one follow-up, a bill splitter with total/tip/people controls, and a coastal itinerary map with numbered pins and place photos. Unlike using ChatGPT, the code is MIT: clone it, plug in your own model, components, and design rules (a separate design-system package holds the theme, SVG, and form styles), and reshape how your product answers; generated HTML/CSS/JS runs in an isolated iframe. Under the hood it is Next.js + CopilotKit on the front and a Python agent on the back; by default OpenAI's chat-latest writes answers and TypeSafe's Jev model picks the presentation each turn, with simple tables via A2UI and charts, diagrams, calculators, and maps via Open Generative UI. An optional MCP server exposes the same UI generation to other agent hosts. Good for designers and front-end people building AI products who want answers that are more than text.
items.promptHint: 克隆 CopilotKit/OpenIntelligentUI，`make setup && make dev` 后打开 http://localhost:3000，先点「Split the bill fairly」看它怎么生成可操作的小工具；再把 packages/design-system 里的主题换成你自己的颜色、字体和圆角，让生成的界面跟你的产品一致。需要自己的 OpenAI 和 TypeSafe（Jev）API key，用量计入你的账户。

You need your own OpenAI and TypeSafe (Jev) API keys, billed to your accounts.

items.title: Shaders：200+ 个开源 WebGPU 特效组件，编程助手可直接接
items.titleEn: Shaders: 200+ open-source WebGPU effect components your coding agent can use
items.summary: Shaders 把渐变、噪点、玻璃、金属、光效、扭曲、转场、鼠标拖尾这类 WebGPU 特效做成一个个组件，React、Vue、Svelte、Solid 和原生 JS 都能用，一层层叠起来就是一张会动的背景或首屏。官网有免费的设计编辑器，调好后导出对应框架的代码。和 Agent 最相关的一点：一行 `npx shaders@latest install-mcp` 就能把它的 MCP 服务装进 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex 等，让助手自己找、装、改你设计的特效，免费账号也能用；另有 llms.txt 给模型读。
items.summaryEn: Shaders turns WebGPU effects such as gradients, noise, glass, metal, light, distortion, transitions, and cursor trails into components for React, Vue, Svelte, Solid, and plain JS; stack a few and you have a moving background or hero. The site has a free design editor that exports code for your framework. The agent-relevant part: one `npx shaders@latest install-mcp` installs its MCP server into Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and others so the agent can find, install, and edit the effects you designed, free accounts included, and there is an llms.txt for models.

items.title: Beautiful UI

items.summaryEn: Primitives for AI-native interfaces: loading, thinking traces, streaming text, approval cards, tool chips, prompt bar. Hand the page to an Agent and let it pick.

items.promptHintEn: Use Beautiful UI’s Approval Card and Thinking for an agent chat. Keep it dark; approvals stay blocked by default.
items.hook: 给 AI 界面的零件：思考轨迹、审批卡和输入条。
items.hookEn: Parts for an AI interface: thinking traces, approval cards, and a prompt bar.

items.title: Buttermax
items.summary: Buttermax 数字制作作品集站：鼠标跟随、3D、液态动效和页面转场都做得很顺，适合拆个人作品集的交互。
items.summaryEn: Buttermax’s digital-production site: mouse-follow, 3D, liquid motion, and page transitions done smoothly — worth taking apart if you’re building a personal portfolio.
items.qualityNote: 风间推荐的交互参考站，标语是 The gold standard in buttery smooth digital production。免登录可逛。
items.qualityNoteEn: An interaction reference recommended for portfolio work. Tagline: the gold standard in buttery smooth digital production. No login to browse.
items.promptHint: 参考 Buttermax 的首屏：大字标 + 中间一件 3D 物 + 少按钮。转场和鼠标跟随要慢、要润，不要堆特效。
items.promptHintEn: Take Buttermax’s first screen: big wordmark, one 3D object in the middle, few buttons. Keep transitions and mouse-follow slow and smooth — don’t pile on effects.
items.hook: 鼠标跟随、液态动效和转场都很顺的作品集站。
items.hookEn: A portfolio worth taking apart for its mouse-follow, liquid motion, and page changes.

items.title: MetalForge Progress
items.summary: MetalForge 的 Progress 进度条着色器：浏览器里免费调参、WebGPU 实时预览，可导出 SwiftUI Metal 或 React Native Skia（导出要 Pro）。
items.summaryEn: MetalForge’s Progress bar shaders: free in-browser tweaking with a live WebGPU preview; export SwiftUI Metal or React Native Skia (export is Pro).
items.qualityNote: 来自 @sucodeee 的进度条动画。现有库以 ThreeUI 为主，这条是同类 GPU UI 动效，编辑器免费可玩，导出文件要 Pro。
items.qualityNoteEn: From @sucodeee’s progress-bar demo. The library is mostly ThreeUI; this is the same GPU-UI family. The editor is free to play; shipping files is Pro.
items.promptHint: 用 MetalForge Progress 做同步/加载进度条。先在编辑器里选 Spring 或 Slosh，换成我们的主色，导出前先截预览给设计看。
items.promptHintEn: Use MetalForge Progress for a sync/loading bar. Pick Spring or Slosh in the editor, switch to our primary color, and screenshot the preview for design before exporting.
items.hook: 在浏览器里调进度条着色器，并能实时预览。
items.hookEn: Progress-bar shaders you can tweak in the browser with a live preview.

items.title: Structure Flow
items.summary: ThreeUI Community 的三维场研究：结构流、轨道球、点阵、星云与流体场等免费变体。免登录，可在浏览页直接预览。
items.qualityNote: 适合当 Agent 的第一块三维 Hero：复制页面里的 prompt / Skill.md，只改色相、点大小和运动速度，不必手改 procedural JS。
items.promptHint: 用 Structure Flow 做产品首屏背景。保持免费 Community 变体，换成我们的主色，放慢速度，点更疏一点。
items.summaryEn: A ThreeUI Community 3D field study: free variants for structure flow, orbit orbs, lattices, nebulae, and fluid fields. No login; preview on the browse page.
items.qualityNoteEn: A good first 3D hero for an Agent: copy the page prompt / Skill.md and only change hue, point size, and speed — no hand-editing of procedural JS.
items.promptHintEn: Use Structure Flow as a product first-screen background. Keep the free Community variant, switch to our primary color, slow it down, and thin out the points.
items.hook: 结构流、星云和流体场，打开就能预览。
items.hookEn: A field study of structure flow, nebulae, and fluid you can preview without signing in.

items.title: Predictive Arc
items.summary: Canvas / WebGL 信号弧：预测弧、像素弧、粒子、网格与半调流动。免费变体都在 Community 目录里。
items.qualityNote: 仪表盘或「推理中」状态很好用。把 prompt 交给 Agent，调 hue / speed，做成自己的数据弧，不要去碰 Pro 变体。
items.promptHint: 把 Predictive Arc 嵌进控制台顶栏。用免费变体，改成品牌琥珀色，速度放慢，保持可读。
items.summaryEn: Canvas / WebGL signal arcs: predictive arc, pixel arc, particles, grid, and halftone flow. Free variants live in the Community directory.
items.qualityNoteEn: Works well for a dashboard or “thinking” state. Hand the prompt to an Agent, tune hue / speed, and make it your data arc — stay off Pro variants.
items.promptHintEn: Drop Predictive Arc into a console top bar. Use a free variant, switch to brand amber, slow it down, and keep it readable.
items.hook: 预测弧、粒子和网格组成的信号弧，适合做流动背景。
items.hookEn: Signal arcs of prediction, particles, and grids, for a flowing background.

items.title: Brand Orbs
items.summary: 一组 Canvas 品牌球：Claude、Cursor、GitHub、Figma 等免费变体，适合做工具墙或集成列表。
items.qualityNote: 集成页图标墙的现成起点。Skill 侧只需换 logo 与尺寸，主题可整组一起改。
items.promptHint: 用 Brand Orbs 做「已接入工具」一排。只保留免费变体，尺寸统一，悬停轻轻转。
items.summaryEn: A set of Canvas brand orbs: free Claude, Cursor, GitHub, Figma, and other variants. Fits a tools wall or integrations list.
items.qualityNoteEn: A ready start for an integrations icon wall. On the Skill side, swap logos and size; the theme can change as a group.
items.promptHintEn: Use Brand Orbs as a “tools we connect” row. Keep free variants only, unify the size, and let hover spin gently.
items.hook: 一排品牌球，适合做工具墙或集成列表。
items.hookEn: A row of brand orbs for a tools wall or an integrations list.

items.title: Rectangle Buttons
items.summary: Community 矩形按钮族：暗玻璃、Launch、点边框、滑动文字、渐变光束等免费 CTA，纯 CSS/DOM。
items.qualityNote: 落地页主按钮最快可换的一套。复制 prompt，改主色和文案即可，Agent 不用重写动效。
items.promptHint: 从 Rectangle Buttons 挑一个免费 CTA。文案改成「开始试用」，主色换成站点强调色。
items.summaryEn: Community rectangle button family: dark glass, Launch, dotted borders, sliding type, gradient beams, and other free CTAs. Pure CSS/DOM.
items.qualityNoteEn: The fastest swap for a landing primary button. Copy the prompt, change color and copy; the Agent does not need to rewrite motion.
items.promptHintEn: Pick a free CTA from Rectangle Buttons. Change the copy to “Start trial” and the color to the site accent.
items.hook: 矩形的主按钮，从暗玻璃到渐变光束都有。
items.hookEn: Rectangle actions, from dark glass to a gradient beam.

items.title: Shader Buttons
items.summary: 着色器按钮：Star Portal、Ignition、Plasma、Thinking 等免费 WebGL 变体，适合高能量 CTA。
items.qualityNote: 想让 Agent 做出「会呼吸」的按钮时用这组。Skill.md 里改色相就够，别手写 GLSL。
items.promptHint: 用 Shader Buttons 的免费 Thinking 变体做「生成中」按钮。换成靛紫色，亮度略降。
items.summaryEn: Shader buttons: free WebGL variants such as Star Portal, Ignition, Plasma, and Thinking. Fits a high-energy CTA.
items.qualityNoteEn: Use this set when you want an Agent to make a button that “breathes.” Changing hue in Skill.md is enough — do not hand-write GLSL.
items.promptHintEn: Use the free Thinking variant from Shader Buttons as a “generating” button. Switch to indigo and drop the brightness a little.
items.hook: 从星门到等离子的着色器按钮，适合醒目的主操作。
items.hookEn: Shader buttons, from a star portal to plasma, for a high-energy action.

items.title: Constellation Field
items.summary: 粒子星座场：漂移、网络、关口流、连线与等高线等免费 Canvas 变体，适合做连接感背景。
items.qualityNote: 多 Agent / 网络叙事的背景。把 prompt 交给 Agent，调密度和描边，主题一换就走。
items.promptHint: 用 Constellation Field 做「协作网络」背景。粒子疏一点，线细一点，颜色跟纸色底和解。
items.summaryEn: Particle constellation fields: free Canvas variants for drift, networks, gate flow, links, and contours. Fits a connected-feeling background.
items.qualityNoteEn: A background for multi-agent / network stories. Hand the prompt to an Agent, tune density and stroke; once the theme changes, ship it.
items.promptHintEn: Use Constellation Field as a “collaboration network” background. Fewer particles, thinner lines, colors that sit with the paper base.
items.hook: 粒子连成的星座场，适合做有连接感的背景。
items.hookEn: Particle constellations for a background that feels connected.

items.title: Landscape
items.summary: 可切换晨昏与天气的三维地貌：日出、正午、日落、夜晚、雨、雪等免费变体。
items.qualityNote: 氛围页或天气产品的现成场景。Agent 按 Skill 换时段即可，不必重建地形。
items.promptHint: 用 Landscape 的日落变体做封面。保持 Community 免费集，不要换成 Pro 地貌。
items.summaryEn: A 3D landscape that can switch time of day and weather: free sunrise, noon, sunset, night, rain, and snow variants.
items.qualityNoteEn: A ready scene for an atmosphere page or weather product. The Agent only needs to change the time of day per the Skill — no need to rebuild terrain.
items.promptHintEn: Use the Landscape sunset variant as a cover. Stay on the free Community set; do not switch to Pro terrain.
items.hook: 可切换晨昏和天气的三维地貌。
items.hookEn: A 3D landscape that switches time of day and weather.

items.hook: 像一本可以翻开的速写本，整页打开就能看。

items.title: Kage

items.promptHint: 用 Kage 做品牌介绍页。标题换成我们的中文名，主色用靛蓝，保持大留白。

items.promptHintEn: Use Kage as a brand intro page. Change the title to our Chinese name, use indigo as the primary, and keep the large leftover space.
items.hook: 偏影与留白的整页模板，标题字体和主色都能改。
items.hookEn: A full-page template of shadow and open space, with type and color you can tune.

items.summary: 整面书架落地页：适合书店、课程目录或「全部作品」索引。Community 免费整页。
items.qualityNote: 目录型站点可直接复用。让 Agent 按 Skill 换书脊颜色与标题，不要重做货架几何。

items.promptHintEn: Use only Sylva’s Living Green. Change the title and primary color. Do not switch to seasonal variants marked PRO.

items.hook: 画廊用的字标，斜向升起、坠落或横扫。
items.hookEn: Gallery wordmarks that rise on a diagonal, fall, or sweep across.

items.hook: 文章开头的字标，适合长文或更新日志的顶栏。
